checks.text: The page heading reads "Invoice Generator" and the status bar shows "Ready".

Typing "Acme Corp" in the field labelled "Client name", "INV-001" in the field labelled "Invoice number", and "2024-06-15" in the field labelled "Issue date" updates the document preview header to show "Acme Corp", "INV-001", and "June 15, 2024".

In the line items table, clicking "Add line item" adds a new row. Typing "Consulting" in the Description field, "10" in Quantity, "150" in Unit price, "0" in Discount, and "8" in Tax rate for that row shows a Subtotal of "$1,500.00", Tax of "$120.00", and the document total updates to "$1,620.00".

Adding a second line item with Description "Travel", Quantity "2", Unit price "75", Discount "10", and Tax rate "8" shows a Subtotal of "$135.00" for that row (2 × 75 × 0.90) and the document total updates to "$1,755.00".
Clicking the "Delete" button on the Travel row removes that row and the document total reverts to "$1,620.00".
Clicking the "Export PDF" button in the toolbar opens a print dialog with the invoice laid out on an A4 sheet showing "Acme Corp", "INV-001", the line items table, and the total "$1,620.00".
Clicking the "Copy to clipboard" button copies the invoice text to the clipboard, and the status bar briefly shows "Copied".
Changing the Tax rate on the Consulting row from "8" to "0" updates the Tax for that row to "$0.00" and the document total to "$1,500.00".

Reload keeps the invoice: after reloading, the fields still show "Acme Corp", "INV-001", "2024-06-15", the Consulting line item with Quantity "10" and Unit price "150", and the document total "$1,500.00".
